name: Elemental Grave (Su)
body:
Benefit(s): The slayer selects one energy type ( acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic). When the slayer deals sneak attack damage, he may choose to make his sneak attack dice deal the selected damage type. All the sneak attack dice must deal the same type of damage.

This talent may be selected multiple times. Each time the slayer selects a different type of elemental damage.

Advanced Options: Slayer Talents & Lethalities ©2014, Rogue Genius Games. Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
